item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
A Heat Advisory is in effect for Benton County with heat index values up to 108 expected Sunday, alongside City of Bentonville meetings on August 11 and 25.
Heat Advisory issued through Sunday evening. The National Weather Service has issued a Heat Advisory for Benton County with heat index values up to 108 expected from noon to 8 PM CDT Sunday.
Combined Committee of the Whole and City Council meets August 11. The council is asked to approve several zoning changes, a vacation of a right of way, and two grants for parks and traffic technology. Agendas for 1 other meeting this period are also published.
